definitions.gloss: healing; fusion; union (of bones, wounds, or tissue)
definitions.explanation: The biological process by which broken bones, separated tissue, or surgical incisions grow back together and rejoin. Used primarily in medical and biological contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{癒合|ゆごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time for a broken bone to heal.

examples.japanese: ⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧、⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癒合|ゆごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいた→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Upon checking with an X-ray, the bone healing was progressing smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癒合|ゆごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Elderly people tend to have slower bone healing compared to younger people.

notes:
Composed of {癒|ゆ} (heal, cure) and ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ (join, unite). A medical term most commonly encountered in discussions of bone fractures, surgical recovery, and wound healing.

The term describes the natural biological process where separated tissue grows back together. When this process fails or is incomplete, the condition is called {癒合不全|ゆごうふぜん} (non-union) or {遷延癒合|せんえんゆごう} (delayed union). In botany, {癒合|ゆごう} can also describe the natural fusion of plant parts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{癒合|ゆごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: bones heal/fuse
- {癒合|ゆごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: healing progresses
- {癒合|ゆごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: healing is slow
- {癒合不全|ゆごうふぜん}: non-union; failure to heal
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{癒合|ゆごう}: complete healing/fusion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{治癒|ちゆ}→治癒：13303_chiyu⟧: healing, cure — broader term for recovery from illness or injury, not limited to tissue joining
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: recovery — general recovery of health or function
- {接合|せつごう}: joining, bonding — a more general term for things joining together, used in both medical and non-medical contexts
